title: Memo with a context window, price and benchmark that name no model id or date, and a price that belongs to a retired model

planted.why: the memo recommends 'Lumen' with a context window, price and benchmark but names no model id and no date, so none of the figures can be tied to a product
$8 per million input tokens and the one-million context claim do not match the supplied price page; $8 belongs to the retired lumen-1-large, so the monthly cost is $320 instead of about $120

proof.python:
m = open('memo.md').read()
p = open('price_page.md').read()
assert 'lumen-' not in m.lower() and '2026' not in m
assert '$8.00' in p and 'retired' in p and '1,000,000' not in p
assert 40 * 8 == 320 and 40 * 3 == 120
